description: Retrieves Trello boards to which a specific member has been invited but has not yet joined.

fields.description: Board fields to return: 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., name,url). Valid fields: closed, dateLastActivity, dateLastView, desc, descData, idOrganization, invitations, invited, labelNames, memberships, name, pinned, powerUps, prefs, shortLink, shortUrl, starred, subscribed, url.
fields.title: Fields

idMember.description: The ID or username of the Trello member whose pending board invitations are to be retrieved. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user. Defaults to 'me' if not provided.
idMember.title: Id Member
